import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 1000005;
    static int n, k, p;
    static int[] fac = new int[MAXN], invFac = new int[MAXN], f = new int[MAXN];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        p = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int maskVal = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            if (((n >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                maskVal |= (1 << i);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= maskVal; i++) {
            int t = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                if (((n >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    t <<= 1;
                    t |= ((i >> j) & 1);
                }
            }
            f[t] = i;
        }

        if ((n & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modPow(k, n, p));
            return;
        }

        fac[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < MAXN; i++) {
            fac[i] = (int)((long)fac[i - 1] * i % p);
        }
        invFac[MAXN - 1] = modPow(fac[MAXN - 1], p - 2, p);
        for (int i = MAXN - 2; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFac[i] = (int)((long)invFac[i + 1] * (i + 1) % p);
        }

        int size = 1;
        while (size < (1 << 20)) size <<= 1;

        int[] a = new int[maskVal + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= maskVal; i++) {
            a[i] = invFac[f[i]];
        }

        a = subsetPowerTransform(a, k, p, size);

        int res = modPow(k, n, p);
        int subtractVal = (int)((long)a[maskVal] * fac[n] % p);
        res = (res - subtractVal + p) % p;
        System.out.println(res);
    }

    static int modPow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
        long result = 1;
        long b = base % mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * b) % mod;
            }
            b = (b * b) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) result;
    }

    static void fwTransform(int[] a, int n, int p, boolean inv) {
        for (int len = 1; len < n; len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += (len << 1)) {
                for (int j = 0; j < len; j++) {
                    int u = a[i + j];
                    int v = a[i + j + len];
                    if (!inv) {
                        a[i + j] = (u + v) % p;
                    } else {
                        a[i + j] = (u - v + p) % p;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[] convolutionPower(int[] a, int k, int p) {
        int n = a.length;
        if (k == 1) return a;
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            int[] temp = convolutionPower(a, k - 1, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)temp[i] * a[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        } else {
            int[] half = convolutionPower(a, k / 2, p);
            int[] res = new int[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j + i < n; j++) {
                    res[i + j] = (int)((res[i + j] + (long)half[i] * half[j]) % p);
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int[] subsetPowerTransform(int[] a, int k, int p, int n) {
        int size = n;
        int[][] fa = new int[20][size];
        int[][] fc = new int[20][size];

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
                fa[i][j] = (j < a.length) ? a[j] : 0;
            }
            fwTransform(fa[i], size, p, false);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int[] v = new int[20];
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                v[j] = fa[j][i];
            }
            v = convolutionPower(v, k, p);
            for (int j = 0; j < 20; j++) {
                fc[j][i] = v[j];
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
            fwTransform(fc[i], size, p, true);
        }

        int[] res = new int[size];
        for (int j = 0; j < size; j++) {
            int c = bitCount(j);
            if (c < 20 && j < a.length) {
                res[j] = fc[c][j];
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int bitCount(int x) {
        return Integer.bitCount(x);
    }
}
